systemStatus.detail:
WED AUG 26, 7:10 AM PT RUN. On schedule, one day after the Aug 25 run. Sources refreshed live: Toast (email), Sling (email), Google Ads (dashboard scrape), Yelp Ads (dashboard scrape). NOT refreshed this run: Google reviews, Google Business Profile, reservations -- those sections are carried forward from Aug 25 and are flagged as such in the data.

1. PAYROLL -- RESOLVED, WITH ONE THING TO WATCH TODAY. Toast confirmed submission at 11:30 AM CST Tue Aug 25 for Default Payroll BIWEEKLY, Aug 9 - Aug 22, pay date Fri Aug 28. Total withdrawal $18,007.95 ($8,041.08 direct deposits + $9,966.87 taxes). THE WITHDRAWAL IS SCHEDULED FOR TODAY, WED AUG 26, from Checking ****0653 -- confirm the balance covers it. Both blocking action items from yesterday (13 days of unapproved tip pools, 4 auto-clockouts) are cleared. VARIANCE TO RECONCILE: yesterday's estimate was $28,571.32, actual withdrawal $18,007.95, a $10,563.37 gap. That is explainable if the estimate covered gross wages while the withdrawal covers net direct deposit plus taxes only, but it is worth one pass against the payroll summary report so the estimate can be trusted next cycle. Still outstanding as standing issues: 9 employees with no timesheets, 25 with no direct deposit. And a NEW auto-clockout appeared Tuesday -- Roberto Reyes Garcia -- to clear before the next cycle.

2. DAY 19 -- FOOD SAFETY ALLEGATION STILL LIVE ON GOOGLE. Donald Clay, 1 star, The Brewhouse listing, public claim of botulism from a taco. Now unanswered across five consecutive runs. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the review queue was NOT re-checked live today, so the count of 8 unanswered is yesterday's figure and could be higher. Guidance is unchanged: pull the Aug 7 lunch prep, hold and cooling logs for the taco station BEFORE anyone writes a word, then post a short, non-defensive reply that moves the conversation offline. Do not argue the medical claim in public and do not delete anything. A draft is staged in reviews.unanswered[].

3. TOAST -- TUESDAY REBOUNDED ON SALES, NOT ON LABOR. TUESDAY AUG 25 (PARTIAL, group email only): net $5,510.60, gross $5,765.90, 215 guests, 160 orders, avg $34.44/order and $25.63/guest. Against Monday that is +91.4% on net and a $7.78 better average order. LABOR 29.3% OF NET -- worse than Monday's 28.8% despite nearly double the revenue, and the third consecutive day above target. The three-day run is 39.8%, 28.8%, 29.3%. Discounts ran hot at 4.4% of gross ($255.30) versus 2.8% Monday -- worth asking who is comping and why. Voids clean at 5 items. One auto-clockout. The single-location email with SDLW, daypart and category detail lands ~7:40 AM, after this run.
MONDAY AUG 24 (NOW FULLY BACKFILLED): net $2,879.70, only -4.5% vs the Monday before, though -15.2% vs the 4-Monday average. ORDERS ROSE 4.9% SDLW (108 vs 103) and guests fell just 5.0% -- so traffic was fine and the miss was ticket size, avg order $26.66 (-8.9%). Labor $830.41 was +5.7% SDLW at 28.8% of net vs 26.1% SDLW: labor dollars UP while sales were DOWN. Dinner carried 64.4% of net, Dining Room 64.5%. Cost flag: voids $85.00 across 5 orders, +132.9% SDLW and +103.0% vs the 4-week average -- the second elevated-void day in three, after Saturday's $259.50.
READ ACROSS THE WEEK: strip out Saturday's $16.7k private-event spike and the underlying business is running $2.9k-$5.5k days with a labor ratio that has not responded to three days of hour cuts. Labor is now the recurring theme, not a one-off Sunday miss.

4. SLING -- TODAY IS LIVE, AND THE RISK IS THE KITCHEN. Wed Aug 26: 8 employees, 8 shifts, 36.00 hours, 0 uncovered, 0 overtime, 0 off. Roster: Isael Salvador Narciso (Cook), Sarah Palmer (Barista), Tony Rincon and Andrew Turner (Bartenders), Christine Vargas, Osmar Beltran and Gabriel Lopez galindo (Servers), Bea Southern (Busser). Shape changed from yesterday -- a busser added, one barista dropped. Five-day trend: Sat 13/82.25 (5.25 OT), Sun 11/55.50 (5.25 OT), Mon 6/25.50 (0 OT), Tue 8/37.66 (0 OT), Wed 8/36.00 (0 OT). Overtime has been zero for three days. THE EXPOSURE: one cook, second day running, on the night a confirmed 10-top birthday dinner is booked for 7:00 PM.

5. GOOGLE ADS -- LIVE SCRAPE, account 343-687-4835, and there are two separate problems now. YESTERDAY AUG 25: 193 impressions, 3 CLICKS, 1.55% CTR, $7.19 spend, $2.40 avg CPC, 0 conversions on the day. Clicks fell 10 -> 3 while cost ROSE $1.48, so CPC went $0.57 -> $2.40 and CTR fell 4.83% -> 1.55%. Paying roughly four times as much per click for a third as many. One day is not a trend, but check the search terms report and whether someone new is bidding against the coffee terms. LAST 7 DAYS (Aug 19-25): 1,665 impressions, 81 clicks, 4.86% CTR, $94.47, 35.00 conversions at $2.70 each -- the best cost-per-conversion on record, and every one of those conversions came from the coffee campaign, which is now 100% of account activity. NEW AND MATERIAL: 'Local store visits and promotions-Performance Max-2', the MAIN RESTAURANT CAMPAIGN and DAY 9 DARK, now displays 'ALL ASSET GROUPS LIMITED BY POLICY' -- as does 'Oldest SB Brewery on Tap'. That changes the fix. This is not a campaign someone forgot to unpause; there is a POLICY BLOCK ON THE ASSET GROUPS that has to be resolved first. Open the campaign, read the asset group policy details, and fix the flagged assets before restarting. It has also now fully aged out of the 7-day window, so the account has no restaurant-side advertising at all. Optimization score 37%; Google is pushing broad match expansion and a target CPA.

6. YELP -- LIVE SCRAPE, AUDIENCE STILL THROTTLED. Estimated audience size is STILL 'LIMITED' -- second consecutive day, with Yelp's warning that control features limit how often the ad shows and raise cost-per-click. It did not self-correct. Reach keeps eroding: ad impressions 38.9k -> 37k, page visits from ads 430 -> 414, page-visit ad share 57% -> 56%, leads from ads 108 -> 103. The good news is efficiency held -- avg CPC flat at $1.11, cost-per-lead flat at $3.71, impression share steady at 78% and lead share 66%. So this is purely a volume problem caused by targeting, and it is fixable: open the Yelp ad targeting controls and loosen whatever filter tightened. Spend Aug 1-25 is $333.88, $13.36/day against a $13/day budget -- on plan. Trailing 12 months: 1,270 ad leads vs 732 organic (63% ad share), 2,002 total, and the forecast dropped 42 -> 35, consistent with the narrowing audience. Lead mix: Website Visits 959 (48%), Directions & Map Views 887 (44%), Calls 130 (6%), CTA Clicks 26 (1%). The Yelp business INBOX STILL SHOWS 15 UNREAD, untouched since Aug 21 -- 5 days.

7. TRIPADVISOR. No analytics or ads email in the last 24 hours. The only TripAdvisor mail in the window is a consumer marketing blast from a different sender. No action.

8. RESERVATIONS -- CARRIED FORWARD, NOT RE-VERIFIED. TONIGHT Wed Aug 26: Rich Davis, 10 guests, 7:00 PM, birthday dinner, confirmed via SpotHopper, (805) 680-6405. This was logged as 'tomorrow' on yesterday's run and is now today. Confirm it is still on, give it a pre-shift mention and a table plan -- one cook. Tomorrow Thu Aug 27: nothing on the books. Gail Gelber, 5 guests, 5:30 PM Sat Oct 10 still confirmed.

WHAT ACTUALLY NEEDS JOAL TODAY: (1) confirm Checking ****0653 covers the $18,007.95 payroll withdrawal landing today; (2) answer the Day-19 botulism review; (3) open the Google Ads PMax asset-group policy block; (4) loosen the Yelp targeting that dropped the audience to Limited; (5) plan tonight's 10-top around a one-cook kitchen.
